fieldSpecs.label: Order total
fieldSpecs.help: The base order amount the two charges below are compared against.

fieldSpecs.label: Delivery charge on orders above the order total
fieldSpecs.help: Charged when the order total is greater than the value above.

fieldSpecs.label: Delivery charge on orders below the order total
fieldSpecs.help: Charged when the order total is lesser than the value above.

fieldSpecs.label: Free delivery for order amounts above
fieldSpecs.help: Leave empty for no free-delivery threshold.

fieldSpecs.label: Free delivery radius
fieldSpecs.help: Orders delivered within this distance are free of charge.

fieldSpecs.label: Buy Any Service charge — completed orders
fieldSpecs.help: Only used by the Buy Any Service / order-anything-nearby flow.

fieldSpecs.label: Buy Any Service charge — cancelled orders
fieldSpecs.help: Kept when a Buy Any Service order is cancelled.

fieldSpecs.label: Distance range from
fieldSpecs.help: The band starts here; the first band of a location starts at 0.

fieldSpecs.label: Distance range to
fieldSpecs.help: The band ends here, or is open-ended.
